title: Experienced Medical Virtual Assistant – U.S. Psychiatry Practice
description:
Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week | Potential for Full-Time | Remote

About the Position

I am a solo psychiatric nurse practitioner with a growing private practice in California, providing outpatient psychiatric care to adults through telehealth and in-person appointments.

I'm looking for an experienced Medical Virtual Assistant to help manage the day-to-day administrative operations of my practice. This is a long-term position starting at 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to transition to full-time as the practice grows.

I'm looking for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working independently after initial onboarding. Prior experience supporting a U.S. medical practice is required, and experience in psychiatry or behavioral health is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

- Respond to patient inquiries through phone calls, text messages, and secure patient portal messaging.

- Manage appointment scheduling, rescheduling, cancellations, and patient follow-ups.

- Coordinate new patient intake, including registration, consent forms, and insurance information.

- Request insurance eligibility and benefits verification from the billing team, follow up as needed, and accurately update patient charts with the information provided to facilitate billing.

- Monitor patient payments, identify outstanding balances, and flag billing discrepancies.

- Maintain accurate patient charts, upload documents, and assist with administrative EHR documentation.

- Maintain patient inquiry trackers and other administrative records.

- Coordinate medical records requests and follow up with prospective patients.

- Follow established workflows, identify discrepancies, and escalate concerns appropriately.

Required Qualifications

- Previous experience as a medical virtual assistant supporting a U.S. healthcare practice.

- Experience with EHR systems, medical scheduling, and patient communication.

- Experience coordinating insurance verification and accurately maintaining patient insurance and billing information in an EHR.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including professional phone communication.

- Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to follow written procedures, manage competing priorities, and work independently.

- Comfortable making and receiving patient phone calls.

- Familiarity with HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

- Reliable internet connection and a private, secure workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting a psychiatry or behavioral health practice.

- Familiarity with PracticeQ/IntakeQ.

- Familiarity with Spruce.

- Experience with patient billing, payment reconciliation, and insurance-related administrative tasks.

- Experience supporting a solo provider or small private practice.

What I'm Looking For

I'm looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, pays close attention to details, and communicates proactively.

Accuracy and follow-through are especially important. The ideal candidate consistently double-checks their work, keeps records up to date, and recognizes when something needs clarification rather than making assumptions.

I provide structured onboarding, written procedures, and training resources. While there will be an initial training period to learn the practice's specific workflows, I need someone who can use these resources effectively and become independent in managing routine administrative tasks.

As the practice grows, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and transition into a full-time position.

Schedule

- Initially 20 hours per week.

- Availability during agreed-upon U.S. Pacific Time business hours is required.

- Potential to transition to full-time as the practice grows.

- Long-term position.

How to Apply

Please apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. Your resume and a brief introduction highlighting your experience supporting U.S. medical practices.

2. The EHR systems you have worked with and your primary responsibilities in previous medical VA positions.

3. Your availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Selected applicants will be contacted for an interview.

title: URGENT - Australian BOOKKEEPER / ACCOUNTANT  for STR & Airbnb Hosts – FULL-TIME REMOTE
description:
*PLEASE READ CAREFULLY AND FOLLOW ALL APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.*



ROLE OVERVIEW:



We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented *Full-Time Australian Bookkeeper / Accounting & Operations Specialist* to join our remote team supporting an Australian short-term rental and property management business.



We are looking for someone with a strong *Australian accounting/bookkeeping background* who can confidently manage financial tasks and be flexible enough to support other areas of the business as needed.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across *bookkeeping, reconciliations, payroll, owner accounting, Guesty, reservations, owner support, and general business administration*.



We are looking for someone with a *can-do attitude, strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage varied responsibilities across different areas of the business.*



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



*Accounting & Bookkeeping*



* Perform regular bank and account reconciliations

* Process accounts payable and accounts receivable

* Prepare and upload batch payments through Australian online banking systems

* Maintain accurate financial records in *Xero*

* Assist with BAS preparation and ensure accurate GST coding

* Manage and reconcile financial transactions

* Perform monthly expense adjustments and account reviews

* Support month-end reporting and financial processes

* Assist with weekly payroll processing

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records and documentation



*Short-Term Rental & Owner Accounting*



* Reconcile Airbnb and other short-term rental platform income

* Reconcile owner statements and owner payments

* Assist with *Guesty trust accounting*

* Review commission fees, owner charges, payments, and related transactions

* Ensure owner payments and financial records are accurate and processed on time

* Work closely with the property management and reservations teams to resolve discrepancies



*Business & Operations Support*



* Liaise with the business owner, Australian accounting contacts, VA team, and other internal stakeholders

* Provide support across different areas of the business as required

* Assist with owner support and financial queries

* Work with *Guesty and reservations-related processes* where required

* Help ensure important tasks, deadlines, payments, reconciliations, and follow-ups remain organized and on track

* Identify issues that require management oversight and escalate them appropriately

* Assist with improving processes and systems as the business continues to grow

* Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR?



We are looking for someone who is not limited to a single set of bookkeeping tasks.



The successful candidate should be:



* *Highly organized and proactive*

* A strong problem-solver who can think independently

* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and switching between different types of tasks

* Willing to learn and take on responsibilities outside traditional bookkeeping

* Able to identify what needs attention and follow up without constant supervision

* Comfortable communicating with business owners, accountants, VAs, and other team members

* Detail-oriented and highly accurate

* Reliable and accountable

* Someone with a *can-do attitude* who is willing to help wherever their skills can add value



As the business grows, there may be opportunities to expand the role into *other industry-specific areas of the business*, particularly around short-term rental operations, owner accounting, Guesty, reservations, and property management.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE — NON-NEGOTIABLE



*The following are required:*



* Minimum *2 years of professional bookkeeping/accounting experience*

* Strong *Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience*

* Experience working with *Australian businesses or Australian clients*

* Strong understanding of *Australian GST and taxation requirements*

* Practical experience with *Xero*

* Experience with bank reconciliations and financial reporting

* Experience with Australian banking and payment processes

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* Excellent written and verbal English communication

* Proficiency in *Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets*

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

* Reliable internet connection



SHORT-TERM RENTAL / AIRBNB EXPERIENCE



Experience working with *Airbnb, short-term rentals, vacation rentals, or property management businesses is strongly preferred but negotiable*.



Candidates with STR experience will have an advantage, particularly those familiar with:



* Airbnb or other booking platforms

* Guesty or similar PMS platforms

* Owner statements and owner payments

* Trust accounting

* Commission calculations

* Reservations and booking-related financial transactions

* Short-term rental revenue reconciliation



However, if you have *strong Australian accounting/bookkeeping experience and Xero expertise*, we are open to candidates who do not have direct Airbnb/STR experience, provided you demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn the industry-specific side of the role.



You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying discrepancies, following up with the right people, keeping the business owner organized, and taking initiative when something needs attention.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS — PLEASE FOLLOW CAREFULLY



*Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.*



To be considered, please begin your application with the following subject line:



*XERO – [Full Name – Preferred Contact Information]*



Please include the following in your application:



*1. Full Name & Contact Information*

Provide your full name and preferred contact details.



*2. Australian Experience*

Briefly describe your experience working with Australian businesses or Australian clients. Include the number of years and the types of businesses you have supported.



*3. Xero Experience*

Explain your level of experience with Xero, including how long you have used it and the accounting/bookkeeping functions you have handled.



*4. Australian Bookkeeping Experience*

Tell us about the bookkeeping/accounting tasks you have handled for Australian businesses.



*5. GST & BAS*

Describe your practical experience with:



* GST

* BAS

* GST coding

* Bank reconciliations

* Australian bookkeeping practices

* Australian banking/payment processes



*6. Airbnb / STR Experience*

Tell us whether you have experience working with:



* Airbnb

* Short-term rentals

* Property management

* Guesty or another PMS

* Owner statements/payments

* Trust accounting



If you do not have STR experience, please state this honestly. *STR experience is preferred but negotiable.*



*7. Additional Skills*

Please tell us about any experience you have with:



* Payroll

* Owner accounting

* Reservations

* Guesty

* Accounts payable/receivable

* Financial reporting

* Australian online banking

* Working with remote VA/property management teams



*8. Availability*

Please indicate your availability for a *full-time position* and your preferred working schedule/time zone.



### FINAL NOTE



We are looking for a long-term team member who can grow with the business.



The ideal candidate will bring a strong **Australian accounting foundation**and the flexibility, initiative, and willingness to learn to support the broader operational needs of a growing short-term rental business.



*You can also message us on the FB Page:  FaithfulStays Hospitality VA*

title: GUEST MEDIATOR / AIRBNB RESOLUTION SPECIALIST
description:
We are a rapidly growing short-term rental management company looking for an experienced *Guest Mediator / Airbnb Resolution Specialist* to join our team.



We already have one Guest Mediator on our team. As our company continues to grow and our reservation volume increases, we are looking to add a *second Mediator* to work alongside our existing team member and help manage the increasing workload.



*This is NOT a standard customer service or Guest Communications position.*



*YOUR JOB BEGINS WHEN SOMETHING GOES WRONG.*



When a guest is upset, reports an issue, wants to cancel, threatens to leave a negative review, requests compensation, or a situation begins escalating, you will step in and take control of the conversation.



*WHAT YOU'LL DO*



Your primary responsibility is *guest recovery and de-escalation.*



• Take over conversations with unhappy or difficult guests

• De-escalate complaints and work to prevent negative experiences from becoming negative reviews

• Turn negative guest experiences into positive resolutions whenever possible

• Communicate confidently during cleaning, maintenance, access, amenity, and property-related issues

• Think quickly and determine the best approach for difficult situations

• Make guests feel heard, understood, and taken care of

• Handle cancellation disputes and complicated reservation situations

• Contact Airbnb Support and advocate for our company when necessary

• Handle Airbnb Resolution Center cases

• Identify reviews that violate Airbnb's Review Policy and pursue legitimate review-removal requests

• Gather screenshots, messages, photos, timelines, and other evidence needed for Airbnb cases

• Work with Guest Communications and Operations to understand what happened before taking over a case

• Document cases and follow them through until resolution

• Coordinate with our existing Guest Mediator to divide cases and workload



*THE TYPE OF PERSON WE NEED*



We are looking for someone who is an *EXCEPTIONALLY GOOD TALKER.*



You need to be quick on your feet and extremely comfortable dealing with upset, frustrated, or difficult guests.



Many situations will not come with a perfect script or SOP. You may receive a case with very little preparation and need to quickly understand what happened, determine the best approach, and confidently take control of the conversation.



If a guest checks in and discovers a problem, we don't want someone who freezes, sends a generic apology, or immediately offers money.



We want someone who knows how to build rapport, acknowledge the guest's frustration, investigate what happened, provide appropriate context, present solutions, and make the guest feel that someone is personally taking responsibility for getting the situation resolved.



You must know how to *READ THE ROOM.*



Every guest is different. What works with one guest may make another guest even more upset. You need to know when to apologize, when to explain, when to listen, when to offer a solution, and when to escalate.



*AIRBNB EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED*



You MUST have previous professional experience working with Airbnb, preferably in:



• Resolutions 1

• Resolutions 2

• Resolutions 3

• Airbnb Escalations

• Airbnb Team Lead / Supervisor



*Previous Airbnb Team Lead or Supervisor experience is a MAJOR PLUS.*



You should already understand how Airbnb handles:



• Guest and host disputes

• Cancellations

• Refund requests

• Resolution Center cases

• Host and guest responsibilities

• Documentation and evidence

• Airbnb Review Policy

• Eligible review-removal situations

• Airbnb Support escalations



*AIRBNB SUPPORT & REVIEW REMOVAL*



This is a major part of the position.



We need someone who knows how to call Airbnb Support, communicate effectively with representatives, build a case, provide the correct documentation, escalate when appropriate, and continue pursuing a legitimate case instead of simply accepting the first "no."



You should have experience identifying reviews that may violate Airbnb's Review Policy and know how to properly present a review-removal request to Airbnb.



You may also assist with cancellations, refund disputes, Resolution Center cases, and other escalated Airbnb matters.



*WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR*



• *Extremely good at talking to people* — You communicate naturally and confidently without sounding like you're reading from a customer-service script.



• *Quick on your feet* — Not every situation will have an SOP. You can assess what is happening and determine the appropriate response quickly.



• *Persuasive* — You understand how to calm someone down, redirect a negative conversation, find common ground, and work toward a resolution.



• *Emotionally intelligent* — You can recognize what an upset guest actually needs from the conversation and adjust your approach accordingly.



• *Confident* — You're comfortable communicating with angry guests and dealing with difficult Airbnb Support cases.



• *Persistent* — If a case requires additional documentation, another call, another follow-up, or an appropriate escalation, you follow through.



• *Solution-oriented* — Your job isn't simply to say, "We're sorry." Your job is to help *RESOLVE THE SITUATION.*



*IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING*



If you *DO NOT* have previous professional Airbnb experience, *PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.*



General VA, BPO, hotel customer service, or short-term rental experience by itself is not enough.



We specifically need candidates with *DIRECT AIRBNB EXPERIENCE* because a major part of this position involves Airbnb escalations, cancellations, Resolution Center cases, and review-removal requests.



If you have never professionally worked with Airbnb, your application will not proceed to the next stage.



*HOW TO APPLY*



Please include:



1. Your exact previous position at Airbnb

2. Which department you worked in (Resolutions 1, 2, 3, Escalations, etc.)

3. How long you worked with Airbnb

4. Whether you were an Agent, SME, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Manager

5. Your experience handling cancellation disputes and Resolution Center cases

6. Your experience with Airbnb's Review Policy and review-removal requests

7. A short example of a difficult guest or host situation you successfully de-escalated

title: Media Sales Executive
description:
About our company:

We are a leading digital media brand covering military, defense, intelligence, and national security topics, built and run by former special operations veterans. We work with top-tier advertisers and sponsors in the defense, tactical gear, and outdoor industries, and we're looking for a driven media sales professional to grow our advertising and sponsorship revenue.



The Role

We're hiring a Media Sales Executive to sell advertising placements, sponsored content, and partnership packages to brands who want to reach our highly engaged, loyal audience. This is a commission-heavy role for someone who wants to be paid on performance and isn't afraid of outbound prospecting, closing deals, and managing client relationships from start to finish.



Responsibilities

Prospect, pitch, and close new advertising and sponsorship deals

Manage a pipeline of media buyers, agencies, and direct brand contacts

Build long-term relationships with repeat advertisers

Negotiate rates, packages, and contract terms

Collaborate with the editorial and content team to develop sponsored content opportunities

Track and report on sales pipeline and revenue against targets



Requirements

Minimum 2+ years of sales experience (any industry — media, advertising, B2B, SaaS, insurance, etc. all considered)

Proven track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote, commission-driven role

Familiarity with military, defense, or tactical/outdoor industries is a plus, but not required



What We Offer

Competitive base salary depending on experience

Uncapped commission structure — top earners can make $200K–$500K+ per year

Remote, flexible work environment

Opportunity to sell for a respected, growing media brand with a loyal niche audience



To Apply

This role requires close attention to detail — a trait we value highly in sales. To be considered, please reply to this posting with the subject line: "SOFREP Sales — [Your Name]" and include:



A brief summary of your sales background and biggest career win

Why you're interested in media/advertising sales specifically

The word "Mandelieu" somewhere in your reply



Applications that don't include all three items will not be reviewed.

title: AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops (US Focus)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and ownership-driven AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops to support US-focused accounting and finance operations within a fast-paced, high-performance environment.



While the role includes core Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable responsibilities, this position is also heavily focused on Finance Operations support, issue resolution, process ownership, and cross-functional coordination.



This is not a purely transactional accounting role. We are looking for someone who can independently manage workflows, proactively resolve accounting and operational issues, identify process gaps, and help improve overall finance operations with minimal supervision.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in AP/AR operations, reconciliations, billing, collections, payment tracking, and financial transaction processing, along with the ability to work cross-functionally and thrive in a fast-paced environment.



This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are highly organized, process-driven, solutions-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities from start to finish.



Who This Role Is For

We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• US accounting and finance environments

• AP/AR and finance operations roles

• Fast-paced and high-volume operations

• Ownership-driven environments with minimal handholding

• Roles requiring accountability, initiative, and problem-solving

• Cross-functional operational support

• Process improvement and issue resolution



Role Overview

The AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops will support and take ownership of key accounting and finance functions including:

• Accounts Payable operations

• Accounts Receivable management

• Billing and invoicing

• Reconciliations and payment tracking

Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity accounting operations, reporting activities, and month-end close processes.

title: E-commerce Operations Assistant – Australian Online Retailer (Full Training Provided, Long-Term)
description:
E-commerce Operations Assistant - Australian Online Retailer (Full Training Provided, Long-Term)



ABOUT US



We're an established Australian online lighting retailer, founded in 2013. We sell through our own BigCommerce store, handle dropship and warehouse orders, and work with both retail and trade customers. We're a small remote team with real systems and detailed written procedures for everything we do.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a long-term operations role, and we're looking for someone to grow with us.



Most of the repetitive work in our business is automated. Your job is the part that needs a person: reading carefully, making good decisions, checking the details and following through.



Day to day, you will:



- Work through our shared inbox (Front) during your shift and make sure every conversation ends up actioned, assigned or scheduled for follow-up

- Complete the next step on each order: checking and sending supplier orders, updating customers, handling exceptions

- Reply to customer
s about orders, delivery, stock and returns, using our step-by-step procedures and AI-assisted drafting tools

- Follow up with suppliers on stock, delivery dates and backorders, and keep customers informed

- Keep order records accurate in Cin7

- Flag anything unusual rather than guessing

- When the inbox is quiet, work through your list of tasks in other areas of the business (such as product listings, catalogue updates and supplier data), and ask for more when you're done



You don't need to know our systems. Every task has a written procedure, and we'll train you on all of it.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE



- Front: shared inbox, where most of your day is spent

- Cin7: orders and inventory

- BigCommerce: our online store

- Google Workspace and Slack



Experience with any of these is a bonus, not a requirement.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- This is your ONLY job. We need your full attention during working hours, so this role isn't suitable if you have other clients or employers.

- You want a stable, long-term role and plan to stay and grow with one company

- You're eager to learn and happy to follow procedures closely

- You take initiative: you follow up without being reminded, and when things are quiet you look for the next useful thing to do rather than waiting

- Clear, careful written English

- Strong attention to detail: you read things properly before acting

- Reliable and responsive: online, focused and reachable for your whole shift

- Stable computer, reliable internet and a quiet place to work



Previous e-commerce or VA experience is welcome but not required. We care more about reliability and attitude than about your CV.



HOURS



- Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM Sydney time (8:00 AM - 2:00 PM Philippine time during Australian daylight saving time)

- We'll start with 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM while you train, then move to the full hours

- Being available and online for these exact hours is a firm requirement

- No weekends



PAY & GROWTH



- Starting rate: $5 - $7 USD/hour, depending on your skills and application

- Up to $8 USD/hour once you move to the full 11 AM - 5 PM schedule, based on the quality and output of your work

- Paid weekly

- Performance bonuses for reliability and quality

- Full training, working directly with the business owner

- A real path to more responsibility as you prove yourself



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word ANCHOR on the first line. Then answer these questions:



1. Do you currently have any other job or clients? If yes, please list them and the hours you work for them.

2. Can you commit to 11 AM - 5 PM Sydney time, Monday to Friday, long-term?

3. Tell us about a time you had to learn something new quickly. How did you go about it?

4. Describe any experience you have with customer
s, orders or online stores. It's fine to say none.

5. Our starting rate is $5 - $7 USD/hour. Where in that range do you see yourself, and why?



Finish with a short paragraph on why you want a long-term role with one company.



Applications without ANCHOR or with missing answers won't be reviewed.

title: Senior Customer Service and Process Manager
description:
Position Overview



Canvas Factory is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Senior Customer Experience & Process Manager to oversee customer service operations while continuously improving the systems, processes and workflows that support the wider business.



This is a hands-on, problem-solving role suited to someone who can move comfortably between customer experience, operational processes, systems, reporting and continuous improvement.



The role requires someone who can look beyond individual customer issues, identify patterns or process failures, and implement practical solutions that improve efficiency, customer outcomes and business performance.



The successful candidate will work closely with management, customer service, design, production, development and other operational teams.



Key Responsibilities



Customer Experience & Customer Service

1. Oversee the overall performance and effectiveness of the Customer Service function.

2. Support the Customer Service team with complex customer issues, escalations and unusual cases.

3. Review recurring customer complaints and identify underlying operational or process issues.

4. Develop practical solutions that improve both the customer experience and internal efficiency.

5. Maintain and improve customer service procedures and internal resources.

6. Ensure customer issues are handled consistently and in line with company expectations.

7. Monitor service quality and identify opportunities for coaching, training or process improvement.



Customer Service/ Design Team Leadership

1. Lead and support a team of approximately seven experienced Customer Service contractors based in the Philippines.

2. Manage recruitment, selection and onboarding of new Customer Service team members as required.

3. Provide leadership to a well-established, highly independent remote team, creating accountability without unnecessary   micromanagement.

4. Monitor individual and team performance using Time Doctor, customer service metrics and quality auditing.

5. Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching sessions and formal performance reviews.

6. Identify performance or behavioral concerns early and manage underperformance appropriately, including implementing performance improvement measures where required.

7. Maintain a strong focus on customer service quality through regular auditing of Zendesk tickets, live chat conversations and customer voice calls.

8. Provide constructive feedback and coaching based on quality audits, customer outcomes and observed performance.

9. Ensure training materials, procedures, knowledge resources and internal documentation remain accurate and up to date as processes change.

10. Maintain a hands-on understanding of day-to-day Customer Service operations and assist the team during periods of high workload or when complex issues arise.

11. Take ownership of escalated customer cases and communicate directly with difficult or dissatisfied customers where management-level intervention is required.

12. Exercise appropriate commercial judgement and authority regarding refunds, reprints, store credits and other customer resolutions, while ensuring decisions remain consistent with company policy and Australian Consumer Law.

13. Foster a positive, engaged and accountable remote-team culture, with an emphasis on collaboration, communication, motivation and individual ownership.

14. Report on Customer Service performance, quality trends, recurring issues and team matters to the Directors, highlighting areas requiring attention or improvement.



Leadership Style

This role requires a manager who is supportive, decisive and accountable without being a micromanager. The existing Customer Service team is experienced and accustomed to working independently, so the successful candidate should be comfortable setting clear expectations, monitoring outcomes and stepping in when needed while allowing capable team members autonomy in their day-to-day work.



You need to be comfortable working autonomously, managing upwards and driving positive change through the business. Initiative is a key skill this role requires. 



Process Improvement

1. Review existing business processes and identify inefficiencies, gaps and unnecessary manual work.

2. Design and implement improved workflows across Customer Service and related operational areas.

3. Investigate recurring production, colour, delivery, artwork and order-processing issues.

4. Develop processes that make issues easier to identify, track and resolve.

5. Work with relevant teams to reduce repeated problems rather than simply resolving individual cases.

6. Document processes clearly so they can be understood and followed by the wider team.

7. Review new processes after implementation and refine them where required.



Systems & Workflow Management

1. Work extensively within systems such as Zendesk, CS-Cart and internal business platforms.

2. Design and maintain ticket workflows, triggers, tags, queues, groups and automations.

3. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflow efficiency.

4. Translate operational requirements into clear requests for developers and technical teams.

5. Test system changes and provide practical feedback before implementation.

6. Ensure system changes support both operational efficiency and a good customer experience.



Data, Reporting & Analysis

1. Use operational and customer service data to identify trends, recurring problems and improvement opportunities.

2. Develop and review reports relating to customer issues, service performance and operational outcomes.

3. Analyse customer behaviour, order history and account activity where required.

4. Use data to support decisions rather than relying solely on individual cases or short-term trends.

5. Present findings and recommendations clearly to management.



Projects & Business Improvement

1. Lead or support projects designed to improve customer experience, operational efficiency or revenue.

2. Research and develop new customer service initiatives and value-added services.

3. Assist with the development and implementation of new products, services and operational programs.

Our goal is to lease apartments on 12-month leases and operate them as professionally managed furnished short-term and medium-term rentals, with the property owner's full knowledge and authorization.

s, and contact information

We will provide a detailed Property Acquisition & VA Guide, calling framework, property criteria, target areas, and lead-tracking workbook.

Required:



- Excellent spoken English and a clear, professional phone presence



- Previous cold-calling, outbound sales, appointment-setting, or lead-generation experience



- Comfortable calling U.S. businesses and speaking with owners/property managers



- Able to sound natural and conversational rather than simply reading a script



- Comfortable handling rejection and objections



- Strong internet research skills



- Excellent attention to detail



- Comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets



- Reliable internet connection



- Quality headset and quiet calling environment



- Dependable, organized, and able to work independently



Strongly Preferred:



- Previous U.S. real estate cold-calling experience



- Experience calling landlords, apartment complexes, property managers, or real estate investors



- Experience identifying property owners or decision-makers



- Experience with lead generation and contact research



- Experience navigating gatekeepers



- Familiarity with U.S. real estate terminology



You do not need previous short-term rental experience. We will provide the information and criteria needed for our specific business model.



What Success Looks Like:



We are not looking for someone who simply makes a large number of calls.



A successful VA will:



- Find the correct decision-maker



- Have professional conversations



- Clearly communicate our intended use



- Identify owners/managers genuinely open to the arrangement



- Collect accurate information



- Keep excellent notes



- Follow up consistently



- Produce qualified landlord opportunities for us to take over



- Quality of leads and conversations matters more than simply maximizing call volume.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with:



“FALLOWFIELD”



Then answer the following questions:



1. How many years of cold-calling or outbound sales experience do you have?

3. Do you have previous U.S. real estate experience? If yes, describe it.

8. Are you available to make calls during U.S. business hours?

10. What hourly rate are you requesting?



11. Voice Recording Required



12. Please include a 45–90 second voice recording with your application.



In the recording:



- Introduce yourself



- Briefly describe your cold-calling experience



- Explain why you would be a good fit for this position



Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared script. We are primarily evaluating your spoken English, confidence, clarity, tone, and phone presence.

- Answer inbound calls live during our business hours

- Log each call in our CRM

What we're looking for:

- Clear, easily understood spoken English and a warm, professional phone manner. Our callers are homeowners in the rural and suburban Midwest, so you need to be comfortable and natural on the phone with them.

- Confident guiding a conversation toward a booking without being pushy

- Able to step away from other work and pick up a call quickly, from a quiet spot with a good headset

- Reliable internet with a backup option

- Available during the full US Eastern daytime window, Monday to Friday



What you get:

- $400 to $800/month steady retainer, depending on experience, paid weekly for your first two months, then twice a month, via Wise or PayPal. Always on time.

- $20 bonus for every estimate you book that takes place. Book 25 in a month and that's an extra $500.

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support), as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Relevant minimum 3 YEARS of experience working for an MSP

• REQUIRED: With AT LEAST 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role.

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

title: eBay Product Listing & Pricing Specialist – Used OEM Auto Parts | Full-Time, Remote
description:
About the Role

We sell used OEM auto parts on eBay Motors. We're hiring a Product Listing & Pricing Specialist to create and maintain accurate, well-priced listings, and to serve as the fitment expert our Account Managers turn to when a part's compatibility with a customer's vehicle isn't clear. Accuracy matters most here. A wrong OEM number, interchange number, or compatibility chart can send the wrong part to a customer.



What You'll Do

Create and update eBay listings: titles, descriptions, photos, OEM numbers, interchange numbers, and compatibility (fitment) charts

Research and confirm part compatibility across Year/Make/Model/Trim/Engine/Drivetrain/Transmission

Support Account Managers when a customer's VIN or vehicle info conflicts with a listing, or fitment is otherwise unclear

Set and adjust pricing based on market research, competitor listings, and part condition

Monitor listing performance (views, watchers, sell-through) and update underperforming listings

Keep OEM numbers, interchange numbers, and compatibility data accurate and up to date as listings change

Flag listing or fitment issues to Management when they can't be resolved internally

Document listing changes and fitment decisions



Requirements

At least 1 year of experience with eBay listing management (eBay Motors or auto parts preferred)

Strong attention to detail, especially with part numbers and compatibility data

Comfortable researching OEM parts, interchange numbers, and vehicle specs (VIN decoding a plus)

Good written English for listing copy and internal communication

Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel)

Able to work independently and flag issues before they become problems



Nice to Have



Background in auto parts (used OEM parts especially)

Experience with eBay Seller Hub and eBay's compatibility chart tools

Basic competitor/pricing research experience for eCommerce

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor - Instagram Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Life's A Pitch (LAP) is looking for a creative, detail-oriented Video Editor to produce engaging short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. You'll work directly with the Founder and team, editing talking-head footage into polished, scroll-worthy videos. The initial focus is short-form content, with opportunities to grow into longer-form YouTube content as our channels develop. This role is ideal for someone who loves social video, has a strong eye for pacing, hooks, and creative storyboarding and is excited to grow alongside a supportive team.





ABOUT THE LAP BUSINESS



LAP is a consulting advisory helping early-stage businesses grow. With our expertise in creating unique, creative and compelling business narratives we assist early-stage companies in growing via capital market and financing initiatives. We serve clients globally across a broad range of sectors, predominantly with a technology focus.





ABOUT YOU & YOUR ROLE



You're passionate about short-form video and understand what makes people stop and watch. You have a strong sense of timing, you take feedback well, and you bring consistent polish to every edit. You're organised, reliable with deadlines, and comfortable working closely with the team on a daily basis. You're curious about new editing and AI tools, and excited to help shape the content as it grows.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Short-Form Editing — Edit raw talking-head footage into polished vertical videos (typically 45–120 seconds).

• Captions & Hooks — Add accurate captions, on-screen text and strong opening hooks.

• Feedback & Revisions — Refine edits based on feedback from the founder and team.

• Content Variations — Create variations of approved videos for testing across platforms (Speed, zoom, motion etc).

• Brand Consistency — Apply our prepared motion kit and brand styling across all content.

• File Management — Organise footage, edits and versions in various tools (e.g. 
, Slack, Airtable)

• Team Collaboration — Work with the team daily via Slack.





WHAT YOU'LL LEARN



You'll get exposure to some of the exciting tools and workflows we use, such as:

• AI Editing Tools — AI-assisted captions, hooks and video workflows such as 
, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Krea

• Content Strategy — what drives performance across Reels, TikTok and Shorts

• Content Systems — build and work woth scalable content production workflow from the ground up

• Channel expanssion — growing from short-form into long-form content over time (e.g. YouTube)





REQUIREMENTS



Must Have

• Proven experience editing short-form social video (talking-head content preferred)

• Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar editing tools

• Strong sense of pacing, hooks and storytelling

• Reliable turnaround and strong attention to detail

• Good written and spoken English

• A portfolio showcasing your short-form editing work



Nice To Have

• Experience with 
 or similar review tools

• Experience with AI video, caption or hook tools

• Basic motion graphics skills (After Effects or similar)

• Some experience editing long-form YouTube content





Contract Specs – Timing, Hours & Pay

• Experience Level: Intermediate

• Full Time - Monday to Friday

• Preferred schedule 8 am to 5 pm PHT - Flexible working arrangements

• Hours/Week: 40

• Duration: Ongoing

Benefits

• Supportive team culture and creative, meaningful work

• Motion kit, brand styling and tool subscriptions provided

• Long-term role with room for growth into YouTube content

title: Personal and Administrative Assistant

title: Senior Accountant – Australian CFO Advisory Firm
description:
Employment type: Part-time, 25 hrs/week to start (Mon–Fri, 5 hrs/day within Australian business hours, UTC+8), with a path to full-time as the client base grows



Salary: USD 9–12 per hour, depending on experience



Job Overview



Australian boutique CFO advisory firm (name disclosed to shortlisted candidates) working with growing owner-managed businesses across construction, professional services, consulting and technology. We provide CFO-level strategy, tax structuring and financial modelling — you will run the execution layer that sits underneath it.



This is a permanent, core role reporting directly to the Principal (CPA / CGMA). You will own client ledgers end-to-end, create the working papers behind our advice, and pick up the ad-hoc work a small advisory firm generates. Our working day is UTC+8 — the same time zone as the Philippines: standard daytime hours, no night shift.



Key Responsibilities



Client bookkeeping (Xero): Bank reconciliations, AP/AR, project and tracking-category coding, quote-to-invoice, purchase-order registers and month-end close across several client files — to a written checklist, without being chased.



Compliance preparation: Draft BAS/IAS and GST reconciliations, payroll and STP, superannuation guarantee.



Creating workpapers: Build reconciled, referenced workpapers from source documents, year-end accounts, balance sheet reconciliations and lead schedules — with every figure agreed to an invoice, statement or ledger and an audit trail a reviewer can follow.



Financial models and reporting: Maintain Excel budget and cash-flow models, monthly management packs and budget-vs-actual reports in our template; flag variances in dollars.



Document control: Keep client folders in SharePoint / Microsoft 365 orderly; maintain the query register; send an end-of-day summary with all open questions batched in one list.



Ad-hoc work: Whatever the week needs — data collection and clean-up, research, formatting reports and proposals, chasing documents, setting up templates and systems, and other tasks the Principal assigns. Flexibility and initiative matter as much as technical skill.



Requirements

3+ years' accounting or bookkeeping for Australian clients (public practice, BPO or direct). You can explain GST, BAS, PAYG withholding, super guarantee and tracking categories without looking them up.

Xero Advisor Certified (Payroll certification a plus). Strong Excel: lookups, pivot tables, structured working papers.

Microsoft 365: Outlook, SharePoint, Teams.

Excellent written English — your work goes to clients under the firm's name.

Accuracy and follow-through: you reconcile to the cent and close the loop on every open item.

Reliable internet with backup power; available 4-5 hours per day within Australian business hours (Mon–Fri, UTC+8); camera on for weekly check-ins.

Nice to Have

CPA (Philippines), or CPA Australia candidate

3 years plus experience

Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to draft, check and speed up work

title: CEO personal assistant — $4-8+/hr DOE — Full-Time, Phone Based — Must Work Central Time — Video In
description:
WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR SOMEONE TO TAKE TASKS OFF MY PLATE. WE ARE HIRING SOMEONE TO KEEP ME ON MY OWN STANDARD, EVERY HOUR OF THE DAY.



If you're picturing a normal VA job where you get a task list and go do it on your own, this isn't that. This role is on a live call with me, essentially the whole day, every day. Your job isn't to do my work. Your job is to make sure I'm never wasting time, never drifting off my checklist, and always operating at my own standard, in real time, not after the fact.



30A Window Washing is a growing home services company in Florida. I'm the owner, and I am the biggest constraint in this business right now, not because I don't know what to do, but because nobody is holding my floor the way I hold everyone else's. I need someone permanently on my hip, on the phone, whose entire job is making sure I stay productive and on standard all day long.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:



Stay on a live call with me through the day, tracking what I'm actually doing against my daily checklist as it happens, not reviewing it after the fact

Call it out the moment I drift off task, get pulled into something low value, or start stalling, and redirect me immediately, don't wait for me to notice it myself

Hold my personal floor and standard the same way I expect it held for my team, meaning you don't let it slide just because I'm the owner

Learn my specific dialect, phrasing, and the way I actually think, well enough to follow me even when I explain something fast or badly

Keep a real record of where my time actually went during the day, so we're working off data, not a guess, on where it leaks

Flag patterns that repeat across days, not just single moments, so we fix the root habit instead of one instance of it



THIS IS NOT A TASK BASED VA JOB. HERE'S WHAT'S REQUIRED:



An iPhone and a genuinely reliable internet connection. This role does not work if the call keeps dropping

8/10 English or higher, spoken. You are talking with me almost the entire day, this is not a writing job

Real availability for a sustained, essentially full workday of live phone time. This isn't something you do between other things

Thick skin and no need to be agreed with. Part of the job is telling me when I'm off my own standard, and I won't always like hearing it in the moment. That's the point, not a bug

Sharp listening and fast pattern recognition. You are not managing a task list, you are managing my attention in real time

**6 days a week required



WHAT WE OFFER:



$4-8/hr DOE to start, paid [weekly/bi-weekly] (a lot of room for growth)

More direct, constant access to me than almost anyone else on the team gets

Real path to grow into a broader right hand or executive assistant role once you've proven you can actually hold this one



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY. Applications that don't follow these exact instructions will not be considered. If you can't follow instructions in a job post, you can't hold my floor either.



Your application subject/first line must read exactly:



SHADOW — [Your Name] — [Your English Self-Rating 1-10]



Answer these 3 questions in your application:

Describe a real time you had to keep someone else accountable in the moment, not through a task list or a message later. What did you actually say to them?

If I'm mid sentence explaining something and you don't fully understand what I mean, what do you do, right then, on the call?

This job pays well for close to a full day of live phone time. Tell me honestly why that works for you, and how long you actually see yourself doing this.

Record a 60-90 second video (Loom or your phone camera) introducing yourself IN ENGLISH, telling me why you're the right fit.



NO VIDEO = NO CONSIDERATION, regardless of how strong your application reads.



If you've read this far and you're still interested, start your application with the word "FLOOR" so I know you actually read the whole post.

title: Short-Form Reel Editor - Fluent English + Strong Storytelling Required
description:
We are looking for a reliable, fast short-form video editor to edit talking-head educational/entertainment content for personalities and brands.



This is NOT a basic “add captions and transitions” editing position.



The most important part of this job is your ability to listen to raw English-speaking footage, understand exactly what the speaker is trying to communicate, and restructure the footage into a clean, engaging 30–120 second video without destroying the natural flow of the conversation.



Raw videos will typically be 3–10 minutes long and need to be condensed into short-form Reels while retaining the strongest and most important information.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will need to:



Watch and fully understand raw talking-head footage in English

Identify the hook, key points, payoff, and unnecessary information

Turn 3–5 minutes of raw footage into a 30–90 second cohesive video

Remove pauses, filler words, repetitions, stutters, tangents, and weak sentences

Rearrange clips when necessary so the speaker's thoughts make logical sense

Maintain natural conversational flow after cuts

Know what information can be removed without changing the meaning

Create strong pacing without making the video feel unnaturally over-edited

Add clean titles/captions

Use punch-ins, crop changes, B-roll or visual changes when appropriate to maintain attention

Edit primarily in CapCut

Export high-quality 4K video

Consistently deliver videos within 24 hours or less

NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



1. You must be fluent in English.



You need to understand spoken English at a level where you can recognize:



Context

Humor

Tone

Sentence structure

Repetition

Filler

Important vs. unimportant information

When two separated sentences can or cannot naturally be connected



If you rely heavily on transcripts or translation software to understand what the speaker is saying, this position is not a good fit.



2. You must understand STORY and INFORMATION FLOW.



We frequently receive edits where individual cuts are technically correct, but the final video no longer makes sense because the editor removed context or connected sentences that do not belong together.



You should be able to take messy or unscripted speech and turn it into:



HOOK → CONTEXT → MAIN POINT → SUPPORTING INFORMATION → PAYOFF



The viewer should never feel like pieces of the conversation are missing.



3. You must be FAST in CapCut.



This is a high-volume position.



You should already be comfortable editing talking-head content quickly and should not need several hours to make simple cuts, captions, punch-ins, and formatting changes.



4. You must be reliable.



We are looking for someone we can send videos to consistently without needing to:



Repeatedly follow up

Explain the same editing rules

Fix basic English mistakes

Completely restructure the video ourselves

Wait several days for simple edits



You must be able to learn our editing style and become increasingly independent.



IMPORTANT — APPLICATION TEST



Do NOT send only a generic application.



Trial Required



Qualified applicants will receive a short editing test/tutorial using the same raw footage.



This will allow us to compare applicants based on the exact same material.



We will primarily evaluate:



English comprehension

What you chose to remove

What you chose to keep

Story structure

Conversational flow

Pacing

Editing speed

Ability to follow instructions



There is ongoing work available for editors who perform well.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills aligned with Australian professional standards. 

Experience with CAD or AutoCAD is highly advantageous, though not essential.

Education

Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

title: Social Media Manager / Video Ed
description:
We run a land clearing and forestry mulching company in Indiana, USA. Our work is extremely visual — big machines turning overgrown, jungle-thick properties into clean, usable land. Before/after transformations, heavy equipment in action, drone-worthy job sites. Our clients range from homeowners to the Indianapolis Colts.



We want to look like the biggest, most professional operator in our state. Your job is to make that happen through consistent, high-quality content.



The Role (Full-Time, 40 hrs/week)

You will own our social media presence end-to-end:

 • Edit short-form videos (Reels / YouTube Shorts /
 video) from raw phone footage our crew shoots on job sites

 • Create before/after photo posts following our established brand guidelines (we have a complete brand system: colors, fonts, watermark, templates)

 • Post daily across
, Instagram, Google Business Profile, and YouTube Shorts

 • Send our crew simple shot lists so the footage you receive keeps getting better

Hours: Work whenever you want. We care about output, not your schedule. No US-hours requirement.



You’re a great fit if:

 • You have 2+ years editing short-form video and can show results — views, follower growth, or engagement you personally drove

 • You understand WHY content performs, not just how to edit it. You have opinions about hooks, pacing, and what makes someone stop scrolling

Pay: $650–800/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly. 13th month pay. Raises tied to performance — if our brand grows, your pay grows.



How to Apply

Start your application with the word TIMBER so I know you read this. Then include:

 1. Links to 3 videos you edited yourself (short-form preferred). For each, one sentence on what YOUR contribution was and how it performed

 2. One specific content idea for a land clearing company — what’s the hook, what’s the format, why will it work?

 3. Your monthly salary expectation

Applications that skip these steps will not be read. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test project ($20–30) before hiring.

title: Client Success & Operations Manager (US Client & Team Management)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Arc Group is looking for an experienced Operations & Client Leadership Manager to take ownership of people, clients, processes, and execution across our growing US business ecosystem.

This is a leadership position, not a basic Client Success, Account Management, Customer Service, or Virtual Assistant role.

We are looking for someone who has already operated at a BPO leadership or operations-management level and is comfortable being accountable for both US client relationships and team performance.

You will be expected to lead, make decisions, enforce standards, solve operational problems, and ensure that work gets done properly without requiring constant direction.

The right person should be able to walk into an operational problem, understand what is happening, determine what needs to change, and drive the team toward the required outcome.



THE ARC GROUP ECOSYSTEM

Arc Remote

A B2B remote staffing and operations company that places, integrates, and manages Philippine talent for US small businesses.

Kipkeh Media

A growing WhatsApp-based media network serving a highly engaged local community and supported by a Philippine operations team.

SetCo

A corporate entity formation and administrative services operation.

As the ecosystem grows, we need a leader who can help ensure that people, clients, systems, and execution remain aligned.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Client Success, Retention & Business Execution: Own the post-sale client relationship for Arc Remote, including kickoff calls, 14-day check-ins, follow-ups, issue resolution, expectation management, and ongoing account health. Your responsibility does not end once a remote worker is placed. You must ensure the client is satisfied with the service, the remote worker is performing effectively, problems are addressed quickly, and the client has a clear reason to continue working with Arc Remote long-term.

Operational Problem-Solving: Identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, and gaps in execution. Take ownership of resolving problems rather than simply escalating them, and provide leadership with clear recommendations when escalation is necessary.

Process & SOP Management: Work closely with the Chief of Staff to implement, improve, and standardize SOPs and operational workflows across Arc Remote, Kipkeh, and SetCo.

Executive Unburdening: Take ownership of recurring client, team, and operational matters so CEO can remain focused on higher-level priorities and business growth.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate people and priorities across multiple workstreams, ensuring that new initiatives and management direction are translated into consistent day-to-day execution.



SKILLS & QUALIFICATION



BPO Leadership Experience: 5+ years of BPO experience with significant experience in Operations Management, Team Leadership, Account Management, Service Delivery, Client Operations, or a similar leadership role working with US accounts.

Proven People Management: Experience managing teams, setting expectations, monitoring performance, providing feedback, addressing performance issues, and maintaining accountability.

US Client Leadership: Demonstrated experience communicating directly with US clients, business owners, or senior stakeholders and managing client expectations professionally.

Client Retention Mindset: Understands that acquiring a client is only the beginning. Able to build trust, identify dissatisfaction early, manage service issues, and work cross-functionally to protect long-term client relationships.

Flawless Professional English: Exceptional written and spoken English with clear, confident communication and the ability to represent the company professionally on US client calls.

High EQ & Leadership: Able to manage difficult conversations, hold people accountable, resolve conflicts, manage expectations, and maintain professionalism under pressure.

High-Agency Execution: You do not wait for step-by-step instructions. You identify what needs to happen, determine the appropriate next steps, take ownership, and follow through until the outcome is achieved.

Operational Mindset: You naturally look for gaps, inefficiencies, recurring problems, and ways to improve how people and processes operate.



COMPENSATION & CAREER GROWTH



Monthly Salary: $1,300 USD / month

This is a fixed monthly compensation for the position.

Long-Term Trajectory: This role is designed for increased responsibility as our ecosystem scales. Strong performance may lead to opportunities for broader operational leadership and senior management responsibilities.



HOW TO APPLY

 Subject Line: Set your
 subject strictly to: CS & Ops Manager - Your Full Name

Application Package: Include a single Google Drive or iCloud link (set permissions to "Anyone with the link can view") containing:

title: Premium Video Editor for Personal Brand — Premiere Pro + After Effects | Long-Term
description:
I’m looking for a high-quality video editor to join my team long-term and help edit content for my personal brand.



This is NOT a position for someone who just knows how to cut videos or add captions.



I’m looking for an editor who understands:

- retention

- storytelling

- pacing

- clean motion graphics

- sound design

- B-roll selection

- visual hierarchy

- how to make educational/business content feel premium



The editing style is not complex but it's clean, modern and professional.



I do NOT want videos overloaded with random effects, memes, constant transitions or unnecessary animations.



Every editing decision should have a reason.



The goal of the content

The videos should feel:

- engaging

- premium

- easy to understand

- high-retention

- professional

- clean

The audience is mainly business owners, founders, marketers and people interested in content/advertising.



I will provide detailed references, branding, B-roll, music references and editing guidelines.

What I’m looking for



You should be comfortable with:

Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects or Both Ideally



I strongly prefer editors using these two programs because I want clean, professional motion graphics and the ability to share/project-manage files when necessary.



You should know how to create:

- smooth motion graphics

- clean typography

- professional captions

- animated charts/numbers

- simple 2D animations

- masking

- tracking

- clean zooms

- screen replacements

- basic compositing

- good sound design

- good color correction

- smooth transitions when necessary



You do NOT need to create extremely complex animations.

I care much more about taste and decision-making than making something complicated.



Editing philosophy



1. The hook matters most

The first 3–15 seconds are extremely important.

The opening should:

- grab attention quickly

- have strong pacing

- use good visual changes

- include clean SFX where appropriate

- create curiosity

- feel creative without becoming overwhelming

I want an editor who understands that the purpose of the hook is not simply to add effects.

It should give the viewer a reason to keep watching.



2. Editing should support the message

B-roll should actually relate to what is being said.

If I mention a company, show the company.

If I mention analytics, show analytics.

If I explain a process, visualize the process.

I strongly prefer real footage, screenshots and relevant visuals over random stock footage.



3. Premium > flashy

The content should look expensive and intentional without looking over-edited.

Element placement, spacing, typography and alignment matter a lot.

Animations need to be smooth.

No sloppy frames, bad masking, incorrect safe zones, random colors or inconsistent branding.



4. Keep the edit varied

Do not use the exact same:

- zoom

- animation

- sound effect

- text treatment

every 10 seconds.

The video should stay visually interesting without feeling repetitive.



5. Audio matters

Voice should always be clean and easy to understand.

Music should match the emotion of the section.

The type of music I normally use includes:

- cinematic

- instrumental

- classical

- technological / modern

- subtle emotional music

Sound effects should support important moments, not play constantly.



6. Tight pacing

Remove:

- unnecessary pauses

- mistakes

- repeated sentences

- boring moments

But don't destroy natural speaking rhythm just to make everything faster.

The goal is:

constant progression without overwhelming the viewer.

References

I have a full editing guide, references and examples that I will provide to selected applicants.

Editing guide:

[YOUR GOOGLE DOC]

Music references:

[YOUR MUSIC FOLDER]

Personal B-roll library:

[YOUR B-ROLL FOLDER]

Please actually study the references before editing.

I want someone who can match the quality/style, not someone who ignores the references and edits everything in their own style.

Very important: portfolio

Do not apply if you cannot show videos similar to the style described above.

I specifically want to see:

- business/personal-brand content

- clean motion graphics

- premium educational videos

- talking-head content

- YouTube content

- professional short-form content



If your portfolio is mainly:

- gaming videos

- meme edits

- anime edits

- wedding videos

- basic CapCut captions

this probably isn’t the right position.



I would rather see 3 excellent, relevant videos than a folder with 50 random edits.



Work & payment

This can become a consistent long-term position.

If you're good, reliable and fast, I will have ongoing work for you.



Compensation will depend on:

- quality

- speed

- reliability

- how many revisions are needed

- complexity of the videos

- volume you can handle

For the right editor, this can grow to $500+/month, with room to increase a lot more as you take on more work and responsibility.



I care about building long-term relationships with editors rather than constantly finding new freelancers.



We'll start with a paid test project before committing to larger volumes.

What I value beyond editing

Technical skill is important.



But I also care heavily about:

- replying consistently

- meeting deadlines

- telling me early if something will be late

- taking feedback well

- learning from previous revisions

- attention to detail

- improving from video to video

If I give the same correction five times, that's a problem.

I want someone who learns my style and gradually needs less supervision, not more.



How to apply

Start your application with:

PREMIUM

If you don't start with this word, I will assume you didn't read the job post.



Then send me:

1. Link to your 3 best and most relevant videos you edited that match the style I'm looking for

2. Your experience with Premiere Pro & After effects

3. Your typical turnaround time for a 5–10 minute YouTube video

4. How many videos you can realistically handle per week



Do not send me a generic ChatGPT application.

I will be looking at your portfolio first.

If your work matches what I’m looking for, I’ll contact you for a test.

title: Construction Estimating & Project Co-ordinator
description:
Company: Established Brisbane commercial builder — mezzanine floors and commercial fit-outs, QLD Australia (QBCC-licensed; company name disclosed to shortlisted candidates) Location: Philippines (remote, full-time, dedicated) Hours: 25hrs+/week aligned to Queensland business hours (AEST, UTC+10 — only 2 hours ahead of PH time) 



About the role



We are a growing Brisbane commercial builder delivering structural steel mezzanines and commercial fit-outs for clients including national waste, gym and industrial operators. Work has picked up strongly and we are building a structured commercial team. This is a core, permanent role — you will own the quoting and cost-control engine of the business, working directly with the CFO and Managing Director under a documented commercial process (our "Won Job Commercial Review" standard). You are not a general VA: this is a technical estimating and contracts administration role for someone with real Australian construction experience.



What you will do



1. Quoting and estimating



Prepare cost plans and client quotations from drawings and specifications: 

package-by-package budgets, preliminaries, margin build-up, and a tender comparison for every job.

Maintain the estimate through to award so the evaluation always matches the signed contract sum and client purchase order — never a stale internal number.



2. Supplier and subcontractor pricing (RFQs)



Issue RFQ packages to our supplier/subcontractor lists for every trade package, chase pricing, and log responses.

Check every incoming quote line-by-line against the tender scope — dimensions, levels, spec, quantities. A cheaper quote for a smaller mezzanine is not a saving; you will be expected to catch that before it reaches an evaluation.

Maintain a quote validity register: track every expiry date, request extensions in writing before award decisions, and never let a purchase order be raised against an expired or verbal price.

Benchmark every package over $10k against market rates (per m², per point, per tonne) and flag High/Fair/Low so we negotiate before award, not after.



3. Job evaluation reports



Prepare the Budget Cost Evaluation workbook for each job and the client-ready job evaluation report: budget vs committed, margin at award, risks, exclusions and allowances — clearly separating what the client has actually bought from internal allowances.



4. Purchase orders and Xero



Raise POs in Xero from approved awards only: current written quote attached, correct job tracking code and package reference, correct GST treatment (including GST-free overseas suppliers), delivery date and correct site address.

Keep the PO register live in Xero — close out billed POs, no duplicates, no orphan drafts, PO status in the register always matching Xero.



5. Project cost management



Monthly cost report per job: committed vs budget, forecast cost at completion, margin movement — actuals pulled from Xero tracking exports, never re-keyed.

Maintain the client and subcontractor variation registers; every variation priced with margin before it is committed, and billed to the client — nothing done at cost by a
.

Support progress claims: flag deposits and milestone claims the day they fall due under the contract terms, and reconcile subcontractor claims against their PO before payment is recommended.



6. Registers and document control



Maintain the standard SharePoint job folder structure (contract, subcontractor quotes and POs, sub billing, client billing, cost report, variations) and subcontractor compliance records (insurances, QBCC licences, SWMS).

Our non-negotiables



Every price in writing. Every quote scope-checked before it counts. No PO against an expired quote. Evaluation equals signed contract. GST checked on every line. Contracting party confirmed before any claim. Xero is the single source of truth — one control workbook per job, nothing typed twice. If you find a discrepancy, you flag it with the dollar amount — you never silently pick a number.



What we need from you

3+ years in quantity surveying, estimating or contracts administration on Australian construction projects (commercial fit-out, structural steel or industrial strongly preferred). Civil/QS engineering background welcome.

Working knowledge of Australian construction practice: GST, progress claims, variations/EOTs, subcontract packages, QBCC/BIF Act awareness a plus.

Xero experience (quotes, POs, bills, tracking categories) or fast proven ability to learn it; strong Excel (lookups, pivots, structured workbooks).

Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

Excellent written English — your evaluation reports go to clients under the company's name.

Reliability is the deal-breaker in this role. Stable fibre internet with backup, backup power, camera-on availability during QLD hours, and a short written end-of-day report every working day

Nice to have

Experience with mezzanine floors, structural steel or D&C fit-out packages

MS Project or programme literacy (critical path basics)

Experience using AI tools (Copilot/ChatGPT/Claude) to draft RFQs and summarise quotes — paired with your own checking

-Strong rate negotiation skills with solid understanding of linehaul, fuel, and accessorial market rates.
