description:
We are a marketing agency that helps service-based businesses generate qualified leads and turn them into booked appointments.



We are looking for a reliable, fast, and well-spoken Appointment Setter / Lead Response Specialist who can call new leads, answer inbound calls, follow up with prospects, and book appointments for the business they are assigned to.



Our agency is responsible for running the ads, generating the leads, setting up the CRM, and creating the follow-up system. Your role will be to help our clients turn those leads into real booked appointments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a phone-heavy role, so communication style, tone, and voice quality matter a lot. We are looking for someone who sounds warm, calm, friendly, professional, and trustworthy on the phone. The goal is to make leads feel comfortable, not pressured.



The main goal is to make sure every lead is contacted within 60 seconds during working hours, properly followed up with, and moved toward a booked appointment. You will work inside the CRM, following our scripts and processes, and updating lead statuses.



RESPONSIBILITIES

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

- Speed-to-Lead: 60 seconds during working hours

- Booking Rate: to be determined based on the client and campaign

- CRM Accuracy: all calls, messages, notes, and lead statuses must be updated properly

- Follow-Up Completion: leads must be followed up with according to the assigned process



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong spoken and written English

- Clear phone voice with no accent or minimal accent

- Previous experience in appointment setting, sales, call center, or customer service preferred

- Comfortable making outbound calls and receiving inbound calls

- Able to follow scripts without sounding robotic

description:
**Creator Partnerships & Collaborations Specialist — Amelia Sieraden**



We’re looking for someone who knows how to turn creator collaborations into real growth for Amelia Sieraden.



We create personalised jewellery designed to carry a meaningful message. We want more people to discover our brand through creators who can tell those stories naturally on Instagram and TikTok. We’re looking for an experienced specialist who can build and run that programme, from finding the right creators to measuring what each collaboration delivers.



**What you’ll own**



- Build a collaboration strategy for our products, audiences and markets.

- Find and assess creators who are a genuine fit for our brand. We care about content quality and audience fit, not just follower count.

- Develop an outreach system that lets us contact enough relevant creators consistently, with thoughtful follow-up.

- Negotiate and manage gifted, paid, affiliate and longer-term partnerships where they make commercial sense.

- Brief creators on the message and deliverables while giving them room to make content that feels authentic to their audience.

- Coordinate products, deadlines, approvals, posting and follow-up so collaborations actually go live.

- Secure clear agreements on content usage and permissions for paid ads when relevant.

- Track outreach, responses, confirmed collaborations, published content, reach, engagement, follower growth, usable video assets and attributable sales.

- Share what is working, what is not, and what we should change next.



**What we’re looking for**



You have hands-on experience growing a consumer brand through creator partnerships. You can show us collaborations you personally sourced and managed, the content they produced and the results they achieved. You’re confident approaching creators, negotiating terms and keeping a busy pipeline moving.



You understand the difference between a creator who makes beautiful content and one who can help us reach the right customers. You also know how to turn successful collaborations into ongoing relationships instead of starting from zero every month.



We move quickly and care about results. You’ll have the freedom to bring ideas, test them and show us what you can achieve. We expect you to take ownership, communicate clearly and follow through.



**Your first four weeks**



We’d like you to propose a practical roadmap covering:



1. **Week 1:** Your assessment of our brand, products and current creator opportunities; the creators you would target first; and the outreach and tracking system you would set up.

2. **Week 2:** Outreach and follow-up underway, with initial creator conversations and collaboration proposals.

3. **Week 3:** Confirmed collaborations, products sent and content briefs agreed.

4. **Week 4:** First content live where creator timelines allow, a clear pipeline for the following month, and a report on early results and lessons.



Tell us what volume you believe is realistic: how many suitable creators you can identify and contact, how many collaborations you expect to confirm, and how many pieces of content you expect to secure. We value credible targets backed by your experience over impressive numbers without a plan.



**To apply, please send us:**



- Two or three creator campaigns or partnerships you personally managed, including your role and measurable results.

- A short outline of how you would approach your first four weeks with Amelia Sieraden.

- Your expected weekly availability, your rate and whether you work independently or with a team.

- An example of how you track a collaboration from first contact through to published content and results.



We’re ready to move quickly with the right person. If you know how to build a creator programme that consistently delivers strong content and measurable brand growth, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Remote - Market Manager
description:
About the Role

MaidPro is seeking a highly organized, proactive, accountable, and solutions-oriented Market Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our branch.



The Market Manager is the central point of coordination between clients, cleaning professionals (“Pros”), leadership, and our remote support team. This is a hands-on role that requires someone who can manage multiple priorities, make decisions independently, communicate clearly, and stay calm and organized when unexpected issues arise.



This position is not limited to administrative work. The Market Manager is responsible for making sure the branch is staffed, scheduled, supported, financially monitored, and operating efficiently every day.



The ideal candidate is someone who naturally takes ownership, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and is comfortable saying, “I see the problem, and here’s how I’m going to solve it.”



Core Responsibilities

1. Daily Operations & Dispatch

Begin each workday at 7:00 AM CST to manage daily operations and housekeeping dispatch.

Review the day's schedule, staffing, call-offs, availability, client requests, and potential scheduling conflicts.

Assign and adjust jobs based on Pro availability, location, estimated cleaning times, client preferences, and branch capacity.

Build and strategically route next-day schedules to maximize productivity and minimize unnecessary travel.

Monitor jobs throughout the day and respond quickly to delays, call-offs, scheduling changes, and other operational issues.

Communicate schedule and ETA changes to clients and Pros as needed.

Ensure all completed jobs are properly closed out in the system.

Review and complete End-of-Day (EOD) reporting accurately and consistently.

Monitor branch capacity and identify staffing or scheduling gaps before they become operational problems.

Maintain accurate office and cleaning supply inventory and coordinate replenishment when necessary.



2. Recruitment, Hiring & Staffing

The Market Manager is responsible for maintaining adequate staffing levels and helping ensure the branch has enough qualified Pros to meet client demand.



Responsibilities include:

Create, post, update, pause, and close job advertisements as needed.

Review applications and identify qualified candidates.

Conduct applicant screening and interviews.

Coordinate interviews with leadership when required.

Communicate with applicants throughout the hiring process.

Assist with hiring decisions and job offers.

Coordinate onboarding for new Pros.

Ensure new employees receive the information, training, and resources needed to begin successfully.

Manage employee offboarding, including communicating next steps and coordinating the return of company property and supplies.

Monitor staffing levels and proactively recruit when additional capacity is needed.



3. Employee & Team Management

Serve as a primary point of support for Pros regarding scheduling, operational questions, client concerns, and workplace issues.



Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and team/start-of-week meetings.

Set clear expectations regarding attendance, availability, quality, communication, and company procedures.

Monitor employee performance and address issues promptly.

Provide coaching and documented feedback when expectations are not being met.

Recognize strong performance and help maintain team morale and accountability.

Coordinate with leadership regarding employee performance concerns, disciplinary matters, and staffing needs.

Maintain accurate employee information and updates in applicable HR systems.



4. Payroll & HR Administration

Maintain accurate employee records and payroll-related information.

Review employee time and attendance information for accuracy.

Submit or coordinate payroll information within established deadlines.

Make employee updates in HR/payroll platforms such as Gusto.

Assist with onboarding documentation and other routine HR administrative responsibilities.

Ensure employee changes, new hires, and separations are communicated to the appropriate teams promptly.



5. Quality Control & Field Compliance

The Market Manager is responsible for maintaining consistent service standards and holding the field team accountable.

Monitor QC forms, client feedback, complaints, and service-related concerns.

Review cleaning photos and other quality documentation submitted by Pros.

Follow up on quality issues and determine appropriate next steps.

Coordinate re-cleans or other corrective actions when necessary.

Monitor compliance with company procedures, including required job documentation and photo submission.

Address repeated compliance issues through coaching, documented warnings, and escalation when appropriate.

Track recurring quality concerns and identify opportunities for additional training.

Work closely with Team Leads or other field leadership to maintain service standards.



6. Client Relations & Customer Service

Serve as a primary point of contact for escalated client concerns and service issues.

Respond professionally and promptly to complaints, questions, scheduling concerns, and service requests.

De-escalate difficult situations while protecting the company's policies and operational standards.

Investigate client concerns by reviewing account history, job notes, schedules, photos, and other available documentation.

Determine appropriate resolutions within company guidelines and escalate matters to leadership when necessary.

Maintain detailed and accurate account notes documenting important client communications, issues, and resolutions.

Follow up with clients when additional communication is required.



7. Accounts Receivable & Financial Administration

Monitor outstanding client balances and Accounts Receivable (AR).

Follow up on overdue or failed payments according to company procedures.

Document payment-related communications and account activity.

Coordinate with the appropriate team members regarding billing questions, refunds, payment issues, and account holds.

Monitor financial information relevant to daily branch operations and escalate discrepancies when necessary.



8. Cross-Functional & Remote Team Coordination

This position works closely with both local and remote teams.

The Market Manager will:

Communicate regularly with remote support staff, including the Philippines-based team, as well as U.S.-based leadership and branch personnel.

Provide clear and complete information when handing off tasks or issues.

Follow through on requests from leadership and other departments.

Keep relevant teams informed of operational changes, staffing issues, client escalations, and other important developments.

Ensure information is documented in the appropriate systems so that the team has visibility into ongoing issues and decisions.



What We Expect From Our Market Manager

This position requires a high level of independence and ownership.



The successful candidate should:

Be comfortable making day-to-day operational decisions without needing constant direction.

Take ownership of problems from identification through resolution.

Follow up on open issues rather than assuming someone else will handle them.

Be comfortable managing several priorities simultaneously.

Respond quickly when unexpected issues arise.

Communicate clearly, professionally, and consistently.

Be comfortable having difficult conversations with employees and clients when necessary.

Maintain confidentiality when handling employee, client, payroll, and financial information.

Be willing to learn and use multiple software systems.

Be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where schedules and priorities can change throughout the day.

Understand that being organized is not enough, this role requires consistent follow-through and accountability.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Previous experience in operations management, branch management, dispatch, office management, or a similar leadership role.

Experience managing employees or field-based teams.

Experience with recruitment, interviewing, onboarding, and employee offboarding.

Strong customer service and conflict-resolution skills.

Experience handling sensitive employee or client situations professionally.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to prioritize urgent issues while still completing administrative responsibilities.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.

Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.

Ability to learn and navigate multiple software platforms.

Experience with payroll or HR platforms; Gusto experience is a plus.

Experience in home services, cleaning, hospitality, field services, or a similar industry is preferred.



Schedule & Availability

This is a full-time Monday–Friday position with a 7:00 AM CST start time.



Because this role is responsible for daily dispatch and branch operations, reliability and punctuality are essential.



The Market Manager must be prepared to:

Be online and ready to begin work at 7:00 AM CST.

Actively monitor operations throughout the workday.

Respond to time-sensitive scheduling, staffing, and client issues.

Adjust priorities when call-offs, emergencies, client concerns, or other unexpected situations arise.

Meet deadlines for scheduling, payroll, reporting, recruitment, and administrative tasks.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Market Manager ensures that:

Jobs are properly staffed and dispatched each day.

Clients receive timely and professional communication.

Pros know where they need to be, what is expected of them, and who to contact when issues arise.

Staffing needs are identified and addressed proactively.

Quality issues are documented and followed through to resolution.

Employee concerns are addressed promptly and appropriately.

Outstanding balances and administrative tasks do not fall through the cracks.

Leadership has accurate and timely information about branch operations.

The branch continues moving forward even when unexpected problems occur.



Ultimately, the Market Manager is accountable for keeping the branch organized, staffed, supported, and operational every day.



How to Apply

If you are interested in the Market Manager position, please follow the application instructions below:

 your updated resume to: 
 and cc 

Use the following subject line: Market Manager Application – [Your Full Name]

In the body of your
, please include:

Your current location

A brief summary of why you believe you would be a good fit for this position

Please do not submit an application without a resume.

Resumes are required for consideration. Applications that do not follow the requested submission instructions may not be considered.



What Happens Next

Applications will be reviewed based on relevant experience, leadership skills, communication, organizational ability, and the requirements of the position.



Qualified candidates will be contacted to schedule an initial interview. Additional interviews or assessments may be required as part of the selection process.



Please make sure your resume is current and that the contact information you provide is accurate.

About Our Company



We are a U.S.-based copier, printer, and office equipment support company serving businesses across North America. We're a Xerox Diamond Provider — one of Xerox's highest-level service partners — and also support other major brands including Lexmark, Canon, HP, Ricoh, Kyocera, Konica Minolta, Brother, and others, plus remote computer and IT support for our customers.



About This Opportunity



We're building a talent pool of qualified Technical Support Specialists who may join our team as opportunities become available. This is not an immediate hiring commitment — we're identifying candidates now so we can reach out as needs arise.



The Role



Approximately 80–90% of the work is copier, printer, and MFP support — hardware and software troubleshooting, error codes, print-quality issues, firmware, drivers, network printing, scan-to
/folder, and device configuration (plus plotters in rare cases).



The remaining 10–20% is general remote computer and IT support — Windows and Mac, computer hardware diagnostics/repairs/upgrades, software installs, and networking. This share may increase over time as we grow our customer base, so strong IT skills are welcome too.

title: Real Estate - Administrative Assistant
description:
The Real Estate Assistant provides administrative, organizational, marketing, and transaction support to a busy REALTOR®. The purpose of this role is to keep the business organized and make sure important details, deadlines, documents, and follow-ups don't fall through the cracks.

This is a full-time, long-term position for someone who is looking to become an important part of a growing real estate business. I am looking for someone who wants stability and longevity in their role, while continuing to grow personally and professionally.

I strongly believe that working full-time in this position should not mean putting your own goals aside. I want the person in this role to feel supported in achieving their own professional, financial and personal goals while building a long-term career alongside me. As the business grows, my intention is for this position and the opportunities within it to grow as well.



Key Responsibilities

-Listings & Seller Support

-Prepare listing paperwork and supporting documents.

-Coordinate photography, video, staging, signage and other listing preparation.

-Gather and organize property information prior to listing.

-Input and maintain listing information in MLS and other applicable systems.

-Upload photos, documents and marketing materials.

-Coordinate showing instructions and manage

-Monitor showing activity and organize feedback.

-Prepare seller updates and showing reports.

-Coordinate open-house materials and logistics.

-Track price changes, condition dates, closing dates and other important listing milestones.

-Ensure listing files are complete and compliant.



Buyer & Transaction Support

-Prepare buyer and offer documentation as directed by the REALTOR®.

-Maintain organized transaction files from accepted offer through closing.

-Track conditions, deposits, amendments, waivers, fulfillments and closing dates.

-Coordinate communication and documentation between clients, lawyers, mortgage professionals, inspectors and other parties as required.

-Ensure all required documents are signed, submitted and filed appropriately.

-Maintain transaction checklists and follow up on outstanding items.

-Assist with closing preparation and post-closing follow-up.

-Database & Client Care

-Maintain and update the client database/CRM.

-Enter new leads and client information.

-Keep client records, notes and contact information current.

-Track important client follow-ups.

-Identify outstanding follow-ups and bring them to the REALTOR®'s attention.



Marketing Support

-Assist with preparing listing marketing materials.

-Upload and organize professional photography and video.

-Assist with social media scheduling and posting when required.

-Prepare feature sheets, brochures, Just Listed/Just Sold materials and other marketing pieces.

-Maintain consistency across online listings and marketing platforms.

-Coordinate print materials, signage and other advertising.

-Help organize content, marketing assets and upcoming campaigns.



Business & Administrative Support

-Maintain Trello boards, checklists and business workflows.

-Keep transaction and listing systems accurate and up to date.

-Organize digital files and documents.

-Manage appointments and scheduling as required.

-Monitor upcoming deadlines and proactively flag anything requiring attention.

-Assist with
 organization and routine correspondence.

-Create and maintain templates, systems and standard operating procedures.

-Help improve workflows and identify opportunities to make the business more efficient.

-Provide general administrative support as the business grows.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Real Estate Assistant is someone who stays one step ahead. Rather than waiting to be told what needs to happen next, they understand the systems and workflows of the business and proactively move tasks forward.

Success in this role means deadlines are never missed, files are complete and organized, listings launch smoothly, transactions progress efficiently, and the REALTOR® can focus on clients and growing the business without having to manage every administrative detail.



Ideal Candidate

-Highly proficient in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently 

-An excellent writer with strong spelling, grammar and attention to detail.

-Extremely organized and detail-oriented.

-Proactive and comfortable taking initiative.

-Able to prioritize competing deadlines.

-Comfortable learning and using technology.

-Reliable, accountable and consistent

-Able to handle confidential information appropriately.

-Comfortable working independently.

-Able to anticipate what needs to happen next rather than relying solely on instructions.

-Interested in a full-time, long-term position and becoming an integral part of the business.

-Motivated by growth and interested in developing their skills, responsibilities and earning potential over time.

-Experience in real estate administration is an asset, particularly familiarity with Ontario real estate transactions, MLS, BrokerBay/Supra, Realm, SkySlope, DigiSign, Trello and Canva.



Growth & Long-Term Opportunity

I want this to be more than simply a job.

My goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow alongside the business. I believe a great working relationship should be mutually beneficial: your success matters too.

There will be opportunities to develop new skills, take on greater responsibility and grow within the role as the business expands. I want to understand your goals and help create a path that allows you to work toward them while maintaining a stable, full-time career here.

The goal is to create a position you can see yourself in for years — not because your own ambitions have been put on hold, but because this role helps you achieve them.

- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via email, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week

HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. title: Graphic Designer I
description:
The Ideal Candidate



Are you a careful, analytical designer who likes getting every detail right before a file goes out the door? Do you do your best work when the process and quality standards are clear, and then you're trusted to run with your projects? Would coworkers describe you as organized, meticulous, and a strong problem solver in your area of expertise? Do you like a steady flow of time-sensitive work and moving between several design orders in a day? Are you factual and precise in how you communicate, and good at turning a customer's request into exactly what they asked for? If so, keep reading.



TerraSlate is looking for a full-time remote Graphic Designer based in the Philippines to join our Graphic Design team. You'll work directly with our customers to create designs, build and edit menus, and deliver accurate, print-ready design orders. This role works 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, on our U.S. Mountain Time schedule of 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM.



We have a high-accountability culture built on our Core Values of Grit, Focus, Growth, and Candor. If you like clear expectations, measurable goals, and a team that moves quickly, you'll fit in well here.



As TerraSlate grows, we're expanding our Graphic Design team. Your work will support customers across hospitality, education, outdoor recreation, healthcare, and many other industries, and it will be printed on some of the most durable paper in the world. This role has a direct effect on customer satisfaction at a two-time Inc. 5000-honored company.



Work Schedule



You'll work TerraSlate's office hours: 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM Mountain Time, Monday through Friday, [including a 30-minute unpaid lunch break]. Because the Philippines doesn't observe daylight saving time, your local hours shift twice a year:

*Mid-March to early November: 9:30 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday night through Saturday morning

*Early November to mid-March: 10:30 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday night through Saturday morning



This is a consistent schedule on your side, so please apply only if you can reliably work these hours every week.



Key Responsibilities



*Serve as a creative expert with deep Adobe Suite experience, communicating regularly by
, video conference, and chat with our US-based graphic design team

*Design new menus tailored to customer specifications and to what our waterproof products can do by turning customer-specific requirements into accurate, well-designed files.

*Complete design revisions quickly and accurately, including menu updates, pricing changes, and brand-consistent designs for returning customers.

*Prepare print-ready files that account for product specs such as size, finish, and Mil thickness.

*Manage a queue of design orders and meet 24- to 48-hour turnaround times under the direction of our Graphic Design Manager.

*Follow TerraSlate's design standards, checklists, and file-prep process on every project, and check your own work before it's sent to the customer or to production.

*Design print and digital materials for clients in hospitality, healthcare, outdoor recreation, and other industries.

*Support internal marketing projects with graphic design work.

*Suggest process improvements that make the design workflow faster or more accurate.

*Keep current on design trends and tools so our work stays fresh.



Qualifications



*Graphic Design Experience: Minimum of 2 years (Required)

*Adobe Creative Suite: Minimum of 2 years, including hands-on experience with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop (Required)

*Core Skills: Strong typography, layout, and design skills, with the ability to follow brand guidelines closely

*English Communication: Clear, professional written and spoken English.

*Detail-Oriented: Exceptional attention to detail. Accuracy in pricing, spelling, and specs matters on every order.

*Organization: Able to manage several time-sensitive orders at once and keep each one moving.

*Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to work through a design or file problem independently.

*Portfolio Requirement: Submit a portfolio of your work. Finalist candidates will complete a paid design test.



Remote Work Requirements



*Must currently live in the Philippines

*Reliable high-speed internet, plus a backup internet connection, and preferred backup power in case of outages

*A computer that can run Adobe Creative Cloud smoothly / TerraSlate-provided Creative Cloud account

*A quiet, private workspace suitable for focused work and communication with our US and Philippines-based team.

*Availability on camera for team meetings and training.



About TerraSlate



TerraSlate manufactures and prints waterproof paper for a wide range of industries and ships products to over 120 countries. We're a three-time Inc. 5000 honoree and a leader in waterproof, rip-proof printing. Along with selling durable paper, we offer custom menus and design services that help organizations communicate clearly in any environment. Our customers include hospitality, education, horticulture, defense, healthcare, supply chain management, and more. We're headquartered in Englewood, Colorado, and we're growing intentionally.



Why You Will Love Working at TerraSlate



A Company With Meaning: We're building a company that's meant to last, one that recognizes the value of each team member and offers real opportunities for growth, recognition, and advancement.



*Employee Culture: Read the Denver Post article on why TerraSlate is a great place to work: 



*Sustainability at the Core: We're the only paper company in the world powered entirely by renewable wind and solar energy, and we support clean water initiatives worldwide.

*Real Recognition: Twice named one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Companies in America, thanks to the drive of our people.

*Room to Grow: Growth is part of TerraSlate's culture, for the company and for each person on the team.

*Meet the CEO: Watch a short video from our CEO: 



Compensation

$1,600/month USD plus, full-time contractor directly hired, paid via direct deposit to your bank account.

Benefits

*6 Paid Holidays Annually

*Holidays observed: U.S. – New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas



How to Apply

We will not review applicants here.   Click this link to apply, upload your resume, and remember to complete our short behavioral survey:

Therapist Genie is seeking an experienced Funding Development & Grant Specialist to help identify, pursue, and secure funding opportunities that support innovation in behavioral health technology, workforce development, mental health access, and professional training initiatives.



This position will support Therapist Genie, an AI-native practice management system designed for behavioral health professionals, as well as related educational and workforce development initiatives through Infinite Learning. We are a female-owned and disabled veteran-owned company committed to improving access to quality mental health care and training opportunities.



The ideal candidate is more than a traditional grant writer. We are looking for a strategic researcher and funding professional who can identify opportunities, assess eligibility, manage applications, and help build a sustainable funding pipeline through grants, partnerships, government programs, and diversity-focused initiatives.



Responsibilities:



Research and identify federal, state, local, foundation, corporate, and private funding opportunities.

Identify opportunities related to healthcare technology, artificial intelligence, behavioral health, workforce development, education, and small business growth.

Research funding opportunities available to women-owned and veteran-owned businesses.

Prepare grant applications, proposals, letters of intent, and supporting documentation.

Coordinate with leadership to gather information needed for submissions.

Maintain funding calendars, deadlines, and compliance requirements.

Track submitted grants, application outcomes, and reporting requirements.

Develop and maintain a database of funding sources, contacts, and strategic partners.

Monitor new funding announcements and provide recommendations to leadership.

Assist in pursuing scholarship and workforce development funding that may support therapist training and continuing education programs.



Qualifications:



Minimum of 3 years of grant writing, proposal development, or funding research experience.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong research and analytical abilities.

Experience with U.S.-based grant opportunities preferred.

Experience working with healthcare, technology, education, workforce development, or nonprofit sectors is highly desirable.

Familiarity with 
, 
, foundation databases, and corporate funding programs preferred.

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple deadlines independently.

Grant Professional Certification (GPC)

Grant Writing Certification

CFRE, PMP, CAPM, or related credentials

Degree in Business, Public Administration, Communications, Nonprofit Management, English, or related field

Funding dollars secured

Compliance and reporting completion rates

Development of strategic funding partnerships

title: Director of Real Estate Sales
description:
Position Overview:



Apollo & Rose Capital Inc. (“ARC”) is seeking an experienced, highly motivated Real Estate Sales Broker Manager to lead, develop, and drive production within ARC’s Real Estate Financing Division. This is a full-time, remote, Salary-Based position designed for a proven sales professional who understands U.S. real estate investment financing and possesses the leadership ability to convert opportunities into funded transactions while developing a high-performing sales organization.

The successful candidate must possess substantive working knowledge of U.S. real estate investment financing, including Fix & Flip Loans, Debt Service Coverage Ratio (“DSCR”) Loans, Ground-Up Construction Loans, and Bridge Loans. 



This position requires considerably more than general sales experience. ARC is seeking an individual who understands real estate investors, can evaluate and discuss investment transactions intelligently, can identify the appropriate financing product based upon a borrower’s objectives and transaction structure, and can effectively manage sales representatives through the entire financing pipeline.

Compensation & Earning Potential

Base Salary: $2,000.00 USD, starting out. 

This range reflects current representative earnings and is not a guarantee of future compensation. A Sales Broker Manager with strong personal production, effective pipeline management, repeat investor relationships, and a productive sales team has the opportunity to exceed this range because commissions and earnings are uncapped.



Essential Responsibilities:

The Real Estate Sales Broker Manager will be responsible for both sales leadership and revenue production. The Manager will oversee real estate financing opportunities from initial prospect contact through qualification, application, lender/program matching, transaction progression, and closing while ensuring accurate and timely CRM documentation. MUST close Five (5) Clients in the first two weeks. 

Primary responsibilities include developing and managing a pipeline of real estate investors, developers, builders, landlords, brokers, wholesalers, and other qualified prospects; conducting financing discovery calls; evaluating borrower objectives and transaction characteristics; explaining appropriate financing solutions; maintaining disciplined follow-up; and working collaboratively with ARC Operations and lending partners to advance qualified transactions toward funding. DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE A PROVEN TRACK RECORD OF UNITED STATES REAL ESTATE SALES. 



The Manager will also be expected to lead and develop ARC’s Real Estate Sales Representatives, establish performance expectations, review pipelines, monitor follow-up activity, coach representatives on sales execution and product knowledge, identify stalled opportunities, conduct regular accountability meetings, and drive measurable production throughout the division.



Required Real Estate Financing Knowledge:

Candidates MUST possess demonstrable knowledge and practical understanding of the following four core financing products:

1. Fix & Flip Loans — Candidates must understand acquisition and rehabilitation financing for investment properties, including purchase price, rehabilitation budget, after-repair value (“ARV”), loan-to-cost (“LTC”), loan-to-value/after-repair-value considerations, borrower experience, liquidity, exit strategy, and short-term investment financing structures.

2. DSCR Loans — Candidates must understand rental-property financing based primarily upon property cash flow and debt-service coverage, including the DSCR calculation, rental income, PITIA/debt-service considerations, LTV, property type, purchase versus refinance transactions, and common investor qualification considerations.

3. Ground-Up Construction Loans — Candidates must understand financing for new residential investment construction, including land acquisition or ownership, construction budgets, project costs, completed value, borrower/developer experience, draw structures, construction timelines, liquidity, and exit strategies.

4. Bridge Loans — Candidates must understand short-term real estate financing used to bridge acquisitions, refinances, property stabilization, liquidity events, and other time-sensitive investment transactions, including collateral, leverage, term, repayment strategy, and exit planning.



Sales Leadership & Management:

The Real Estate Sales Broker Manager will establish and maintain a performance-driven sales culture built upon responsiveness, professionalism, accountability, accurate product knowledge, disciplined follow-up, and measurable results.



The Manager will be expected to monitor representative activity and performance across critical metrics, including:

Lead Contact → Discovery → Pre-Qualification → Application → Documentation → Program/Lender Match → Submission → Term Structure → Closing → Funded Transaction → Repeat Business/Referral

The Manager must ensure that sales representatives understand that the objective is not merely to generate activity, but to create qualified opportunities and funded transactions.



Investor & Referral Relationship Development:

The Manager will actively develop relationships with real estate investors, developers, builders, landlords, real estate brokers and agents, wholesalers, property managers, contractors, investor organizations, and other appropriate referral sources.



ARC places significant emphasis on developing repeat borrowers. Accordingly, the Manager should be capable of turning an initial transaction into a long-term financing relationship by understanding the investor’s acquisition strategy, portfolio objectives, future projects, and anticipated financing requirements.

CRM & Pipeline Accountability. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating within a structured CRM environment and will be responsible for ensuring that all leads, communications, appointments, applications, documents, follow-ups, transaction stages, and material developments are accurately recorded within ARC’s designated systems.

The Manager will work closely with Operations to maintain an orderly Sales-to-Operations handoff and ensure that qualified transactions contain the information necessary for efficient processing.

Professional & Compliance Standards. The Real Estate Sales Broker Manager must maintain professional, accurate, and compliant communications with prospective borrowers, clients, referral partners, lenders, and ARC personnel.

Representatives must never guarantee loan approval, interest rates, leverage, appraisal values, loan amounts, closing dates, funding, construction draws, or other lender decisions. Financing terms are subject to applicable underwriting, lender requirements, transaction characteristics, documentation, and applicable law.

The Manager is responsible for reinforcing these standards throughout the Real Estate Sales Team.



Required Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in real estate investment lending, private lending, hard-money lending, commercial mortgage brokerage, real estate finance, or a closely related field, together with a proven record of sales production and leadership.

Candidates should possess excellent communication and negotiation skills; strong knowledge of investment-property transactions; experience managing pipelines and sales personnel; the ability to communicate confidently with sophisticated investors and developers; proficiency with CRM systems; strong organizational discipline; and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Experience developing referral relationships and repeat-investor business is strongly preferred.



About Apollo & Rose Capital Inc.

Apollo & Rose Capital Inc. provides financing solutions for real estate investors and developers, including:

Fix & Flip | DSCR | Ground-Up Construction | Bridge Financing

ARC is committed to providing investors with responsive service, informed financing guidance, efficient transaction management, and long-term relationship support.



Dr. Andrew Roach, 

Chief Operating Officer. 



Apollo & Rose Capital Inc.

title: Lead Recruiter
description:

Elite Staffing is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Lead Virtual Assistant (VA) to

manage our end-to-end recruitment pipeline, client coordination, and onboarding operations. The

successful candidate will initially undergo comprehensive training on Elite Staffing's standard operating

procedures (SOPs) and core systems necessary to successfully execute all administrative, client-facing,

and candidate management functions. This person will then train and manage other recruiters.

• Actively source qualified candidates using advanced search techniques and internal networks.

role.

• Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly master new platforms, software, and internal

SOPs.

• Rigorous organizational capability, handling sensitive data and documentation with high

confidentiality

title: Executive Growth Assistant
description:
💗 NOW HIRING: Executive & Growth Assistant to the CEO



Remote | Part-Time | Philippines-Based | 25 Hours/Week



We are looking for a motivated, organized, outgoing, and sales-minded Executive & Growth Assistant to work directly alongside the CEO and help grow her personal brand and businesses.



This is NOT just a traditional VA position.



I am looking for someone who can become my right-hand person when it comes to lead generation, outreach, appointment setting, social media engagement, organization, and day-to-day growth activities.



If you love social media, talking to people online, staying organized, hitting goals, and being part of a growing brand — this could be a great fit. 💗



I’d add this right after the opening paragraph so they immediately understand what they’re helping build:



ABOUT THE BRANDS: 💗



You’ll be working directly with me to help grow both my personal brand, Marienna Mercedes, and ACQHer — a growing revenue growth agency and education brand built around revenue strategy, AI, systems, and entrepreneurship. 



ACQHer Academy trains and equips women to become Revenue Growth Partners, giving them the skills, tools, and systems to help businesses grow and scale. 



ACQHer Agency is the client-facing side of the brand, connecting creators, founders, and businesses with Revenue Growth Partners who help identify revenue opportunities and implement the funnels, AI, automation, sales, and operational systems behind growth. You’ll be helping grow the audience, generate leads, build relationships, book calls, and ultimately expand both sides of the ACQHer ecosystem — while also supporting the growth of my personal brand as its founder. 💗💸



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:



Your responsibilities will include:



- Sending daily cold DMs through Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Threads, and other platforms using provided scripts

- Finding and researching qualified leads/prospects

- Following up with leads and maintaining conversations

- Qualifying prospects and helping move them toward **applications + booked calls**

- Appointment setting

- Helping promote and sell digital products/programs through conversations

- Engaging with targeted accounts daily through comments, likes, Stories, etc.

- Assisting with social media management and posting Stories/content when needed

- Responding to basic customer/student questions

- Helping manage online communities

- Keeping lead lists and CRM information organized

- Tracking outreach, responses, booked calls, and sales

- Completing daily KPIs

- Sending an **End-of-Day Report** so we always know what was accomplished



SCHEDULE:

Approximately 25 hours per week / 3–5 hours per day, Monday–Friday.



You must be available for some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



The exact daily schedule can have some flexibility, but consistency and communication are extremely important.



COMPENSATION:



First 60 Days: $100/week  

After 60 Days: $150/week  

After 90 Days: $200/week



There will also be opportunities for performance-based pay increases, bonuses, and commission.



For qualifying sales generated through your outreach, you will be paid 3% commission — for example, a $3,000 sale would equal an additional $90 commission pay that week.



Performance/pay can be reviewed approximately every six months as the role and company continue to grow.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



Someone who is:



✨ Extremely reliable  

✨ Fluent/strong in written English  

✨ Friendly and confident talking to strangers online 

✨ Comfortable with sales and outreach  

✨ Familiar with Instagram,
, LinkedIn and other social platforms  

✨ Organized and detail-oriented  

✨ Able to follow scripts while still sounding HUMAN  

✨ Self-motivated  

✨ Comfortable learning new AI/software tools  

✨ Able to track KPIs and work toward daily goals  

✨ Interested in growing into a larger role over time



Experience with appointment setting, cold outreach, social media management, lead generation, CRM systems, AI tools, or online businesses is a major plus.



💗 THE BIGGER OPPORTUNITY:



I'm not looking for someone who wants to stay a basic VA forever.



I'm building multiple brands and growing ACQHer, and I want someone who can grow alongside the company.



As you prove yourself and learn the business, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility, higher compensation, leadership, and potentially help manage other VAs/setters as the team grows.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become an important part of what we're building — not someone simply checking tasks off a list.



To Apply:  

Please send me your resume.



When applying, please include your experience with cold outreach, appointment setting, social media, sales, and virtual-assistant work, along with why you think you'd be a great fit for this position. 💗
